spreads.title: A garden called Eden
spreads.stagingNote: Draft visual staging: Adam stands near a touch-responsive tree in front of an upright garden painting; the painted floor is a separate horizontal print.

segments.text: God made the heavens and the earth, then planted a beautiful garden called Eden. He placed Adam there to tend it and enjoy its trees.

narration.recordedText: God made the heavens and the earth, then planted a beautiful garden called Eden. He placed Adam there to tend it and enjoy its trees.

segments.text: God breathed life into Adam. Every creature had a place, but Adam needed a companion.

narration.recordedText: God breathed life into Adam. Every creature had a place, but Adam needed a companion.

interaction.label: Gently touch the garden tree
interaction.response: The paper tree gives a quiet rustle.

spreads.title: A companion and a command
spreads.stagingNote: Draft visual staging: Adam and Eve are separate anchored atlas cards; a serpent-and-branch prop adds depth without changing the retelling text.

segments.text: God made Eve from Adam's side and brought her to him. They belonged together, unashamed and at peace.

narration.recordedText: God made Eve from Adam's side and brought her to him. They belonged together, unashamed and at peace.

segments.text: God gave them the garden's fruit, but one tree was forbidden: the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. He warned them not to eat it.

narration.recordedText: God gave them the garden's fruit, but one tree was forbidden: the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. He warned them not to eat it.
